data.label: Synthetic alert generator
data.description: Existing synthetic alert feed (outside provisioning scope). Publishes alert JSON.

data.label: Approved logs
data.description: Approved log sources exported via a log sink to the evidence store; only allow-listed logs are included.

data.label: Asset context
data.description: Asset metadata (owner, criticality, exposure) exported to BigQuery for enrichment.

data.label: Alert ingestion topic
data.description: Receives alerts; push subscription to redaction with retry and dead-letter policy.

data.label: Dead-letter topic
data.description: Holds alerts that repeatedly fail processing for review; alerted via Cloud Monitoring.

data.label: Redaction service
data.description: Masks personal data and secrets in alerts and log excerpts before storage or model use; treats alert content as untrusted.

data.label: Evidence store
data.description: Redacted alerts, approved log excerpts and asset context, partitioned by time with retention to be agreed.

data.label: Triage orchestrator
data.description: Retrieves bounded evidence for the alert, calls the model, validates structured output (severity, rationale, cited evidence IDs, proposed response). Read-only: has no permission to act on hosts or identities. Idempotent per alert ID.

data.label: Triage model
data.description: Model and regional availability to be verified; mocked with scripted responses in local tests.

data.label: Analyst case queue
data.description: Cases with triage proposal and evidence; analysts accept, edit or reject. No action is executed by the system.
data.service: Firestore + Cloud Run console behind IAP

data.label: Security analyst
data.description: Reviews proposals and decides any response outside this system.

data.label: Audit trail
data.description: Append-only record of inputs, evidence IDs, model version, proposal and analyst decision; monitoring of failures and DLQ depth.
data.service: BigQuery audit dataset + Cloud Audit Logs + Cloud Monitoring

discovery.problem: Proposal-only triage: no host isolation, user disablement or payload execution. Synthetic alerts, approved logs and asset context only.

brief.application: Use Google Cloud for this synthetic architecture qualification. Triage synthetic security alerts using approved logs and asset context. Include ingestion, redaction, evidence retrieval, AI triage, an analyst queue and an auditable response proposal. Do not isolate hosts, disable users or execute payloads automatically. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

lastAsked.question: Where do the files live, and roughly how many are there?
lastAsked.beginner: For example “SharePoint and a shared drive, about 20,000 files”.

requirements.statement: The system only proposes responses; it must have no permission to isolate hosts, disable users or execute payloads, and a person decides every action.
requirements.rationale: Stops a model error or a prompt injection in alert content from causing a real containment action.
requirements.basis: User: "Do not isolate hosts, disable users or execute payloads automatically."

requirements.statement: Personal data and secrets in alerts and logs are redacted before they are stored as evidence or sent to the model.
requirements.rationale: Limits exposure of sensitive data to the model and to analysts.
requirements.basis: User asked for redaction; diagram components redact and evidence.

requirements.statement: Each proposal records its input alert, cited evidence IDs, model version and the analyst's decision in an append-only audit store.
requirements.rationale: Lets reviewers reconstruct why a response was proposed and who approved it.
